text:
For the first time in along while, I'm not actually working on anything. I do some vibe coding for fun.

I'm kinda leaning towards vibe coding my own GUI coding agent. I currently use Pi and recently have been playing with Herdr and Paseo, but none of these feels right to me. These are amazing tools, but ai think we could do better. But I'm very hesitant - I know the only way to "succeed" in a project like this is to write (vibe code) hundreds of thousands of lines of code and it's kinda depressing.
